2236be47-47be-5236-83622-2236be472236.name: The White Shark of Basra
2236be47-47be-5236-83622-2236be472236.description: An old pirate lord, 73 years old, with white hair and cunning eyes. Plans to distribute his vast treasure on the island ruins.

attributes.secrets: The ruins were once the palace of a legendary vizier, now haunted by a capricious efreet. The Shark knows more than he lets on.

1b93ef25-25ef-5b93-8931b-1b93ef251b93.name: Faruq Night-Eater
1b93ef25-25ef-5b93-8931b-1b93ef251b93.description: A fearsome pirate lieutenant. 'Night-Eater' is not a metaphorical title.

attributes.secrets: Secretly plans to betray the White Shark and claim the treasure for himself.

2fe80dd8-d80d-5fe8-8e82f-2fe80dd82fe8.name: Nefru-Sekhem
2fe80dd8-d80d-5fe8-8e82f-2fe80dd82fe8.description: A towering warrior serving as the White Shark's enforcer.

1dbbede4-e4ed-5dbb-8bb1d-1dbbede41dbb.name: Timzahi
1dbbede4-e4ed-5dbb-8bb1d-1dbbede41dbb.description: Another of the White Shark's elite guards. Identical in build to Nefru-Sekhem.

4fde788b-8b78-5fde-8de4f-4fde788b4fde.name: Varazdat
4fde788b-8b78-5fde-8de4f-4fde788b4fde.description: A massive warrior of ambiguous allegiance. Serves as gatekeeper to the palace ruins.

attributes.secrets: Bound by an ancient oath to guard the palace. Will respect anyone who speaks the old words.

196cd99e-9ed9-596c-86c19-196cd99e196c.name: Ibrahim the Drifted Lord
196cd99e-9ed9-596c-86c19-196cd99e196c.description: A displaced noble who has wandered into the ruins seeking redemption.

attributes.secrets: Knows the location of a hidden vault, but fears what guards it.

1d966b39-396b-5d96-8961d-1d966b391d96.name: Keeper of Cups and Cushions
1d966b39-396b-5d96-8961d-1d966b391d96.description: A ghostly servant who still tends to a feast that ended centuries ago.

attributes.secrets: Will help anyone who honors the traditions of hospitality.

1dead3e4-e4d3-5dea-8ea1d-1dead3e41dea.name: Debbi
1dead3e4-e4d3-5dea-8ea1d-1dead3e41dea.description: A tunnel dweller who knows the secret passages of the palace.

1d42ed81-81ed-5d42-8421d-1d42ed811d42.name: Sangtarash the Mercenary
1d42ed81-81ed-5d42-8421d-1d42ed811d42.description: A sellsword hired by the White Shark. Fights for coin, not loyalty.

797c77a7-a777-597c-87c79-797c77a7797c.name: Rafiq the Pirate
797c77a7-a777-597c-87c79-797c77a7797c.description: One of the White Shark's rank-and-file pirates.

4709f228-28f2-5709-80947-4709f2284709.name: Pirate Archer
4709f228-28f2-5709-80947-4709f2284709.description: An archer serving in the White Shark's crew.

533e29c1-c129-533e-83e53-533e29c1533e.name: Ropeburn the Pirate
533e29c1-c129-533e-83e53-533e29c1533e.description: A grizzled pirate with burn scars covering his hands.

4bf6d99f-9fd9-5bf6-8f64b-4bf6d99f4bf6.name: Pirate Treasure Hauler
4bf6d99f-9fd9-5bf6-8f64b-4bf6d99f4bf6.description: A strong but simple pirate tasked with moving treasure chests.

52548743-4387-5254-85452-525487435254.name: Tariq the Monkey
52548743-4387-5254-85452-525487435254.description: An agile little thief who skitters through the tunnels. Named for his climbing ability.

2a4ecd70-70cd-5a4e-84e2a-2a4ecd702a4e.name: Rashid the Jackal
2a4ecd70-70cd-5a4e-84e2a-2a4ecd702a4e.description: A cunning informant who operates in the shadows. Known for his ability to gather secrets and trade them for favors.

1c2d0eb0-b00e-5c2d-82d1c-1c2d0eb01c2d.name: Hound of Ash Silk
1c2d0eb0-b00e-5c2d-82d1c-1c2d0eb01c2d.description: A spectral hound with fur made of ash and silk. Guards the palace entrance and attacks intruders.

attributes.environment: Ancient palace ruins, partially collapsed, haunted by an efreet
attributes.description_long: The crumbling palace of a legendary vizier, now haunted by a capricious efreet. The White Shark of Basra has claimed it as the site for his treasure distribution. The ruins are filled with traps, monsters, and the remnants of ancient magic.

attributes.environment: Grand entrance hall, 60-foot ceilings, crumbling pillars
attributes.description_long: The main entrance to the palace. Massive stone doors stand partially open, revealing a hall lined with crumbling pillars. Faded murals depicting ancient victories cover the walls.

attributes.environment: Palace upper floors, guest quarters, audience chambers
attributes.description_long: The upper floors of the palace, once reserved for honored guests. Now occupied by the White Shark's crew. Dusty tapestries and broken furniture litter the corridors.

attributes.environment: Underground chambers, treasury vaults, ancient laboratories
attributes.description_long: The basement levels of the palace, where the vizier kept his most precious treasures and conducted his arcane experiments. Dark, cramped, and filled with ancient traps.

attributes.environment: Narrow service tunnels, connecting various parts of the palace
attributes.description_long: A network of narrow tunnels used by the palace builders and servants. Now home to various creatures and tunnel dwellers.

attributes.environment: Massive vaulted chamber, filled with ancient treasure chests
attributes.description_long: The grand hall where the White Shark plans to distribute his treasure. Piles of gold, gems, and artifacts fill the room. The efreet watches from the shadows, waiting for the right moment to strike.

attributes.environment: Long dining hall, tables set for a feast that never ended
attributes.description_long: A grand dining hall where ghostly servants still tend to a feast that was interrupted centuries ago. The food is dust, the wine is vapor, but the servants remain.

attributes.setup: As the party enters the Gate Hall, giant cobras descend from the crumbling ceiling.
attributes.tactics: The cobras attack from above, using surprise to gain advantage. They target the weakest-looking party member first.

attributes.setup: A patrol of three pirates rounds the corner, weapons drawn.
attributes.tactics: The archer fires from behind while the others engage in melee. They retreat if two fall.

attributes.setup: Two massive warriors block the path, weapons ready. They fight to the death.
attributes.tactics: Nefru-Sekhem and Timzahi fight in tandem, covering each other's flanks. They target healers first.

attributes.setup: The efreet reveals itself, demanding tribute or combat. The temperature rises as flames dance in its eyes.
attributes.tactics: The efreet uses fireballs to control the battlefield, targeting groups. It picks off stragglers with flame touch. If reduced to half HP, it retreats to bargain.

attributes.setup: Screeching fills the narrow tunnels as ghul-birds swoop down from above.
attributes.tactics: The ghul-birds attack in waves, using the narrow tunnels to prevent the party from fighting effectively.

attributes.setup: A massive, impossible creature blocks the passage. It has too many mouths, too many eyes, and it is very, very hungry.
attributes.tactics: The Dodecaphage uses its immense size to fill the corridor, forcing the party to fight in cramped conditions. It swallows targets whole.

attributes.trigger: A pressure plate in the center of the hallway.
attributes.countermeasures: The pressure plate can be spotted with a DC 15 Perception check. It can be disabled with a DC 13 Investigation check.

attributes.trigger: Opening a treasure chest triggers a burst of flame from the walls.
A section of floor gives way under weight.

attributes.beats:
1. The party's ship approaches the island at dawn.
2. They see the ruined palace rising from the jungle.
3. A warning: fresh footprints in the sand — someone else is here.
4. The gate stands ajar, inviting them in.

1. The party enters the grand hall, awestruck by its scale.
2. Faded murals tell the story of a vizier's rise and fall.
3. A ghostly voice whispers: 'Turn back... or join the feast eternal.'
4. Ibrahim the Drifted Lord approaches cautiously.

1. The temperature rises as the party enters the Treasure Hall.
2. Flames dance in the shadows — the efreet reveals itself.
3. It demands tribute: 'Kneel, and I shall grant you riches beyond measure.'
4. If refused, it attacks with terrifying fury.

1. The White Shark and his elite guards surround the party.
2. The efreet watches, amused, from its throne of gold.
3. The battle rages — friend and foe fall alike.
4. Victory: the treasure is claimed, but at what cost?

attributes.objective: Travel to the island and find the entrance to Uzrah's Palace.
attributes.secrets: The palace is not abandoned — the White Shark's crew has already claimed it.

attributes.objective: Defeat or drive off the White Shark of Basra and his crew before they can claim the treasure.
attributes.secrets: The White Shark knows more about the palace than he lets on — he seeks a specific artifact.

attributes.objective: Deal with the capricious efreet that haunts the palace. Befriend, banish, or destroy it.
attributes.secrets: The efreet was bound to the palace centuries ago. It can be freed — or bound tighter.

attributes.objective: Find and claim the legendary treasure of Uzrah's Palace.
attributes.secrets: The treasure is not what it seems — it is both a blessing and a curse.

pages: Uzrah's Palace was built centuries ago by a legendary vizier who served the sultan of a great desert kingdom. The palace was a marvel of architecture, with soaring towers and lush gardens.

The vizier was known for his wisdom and wealth, but also for his pride. He made a bargain with an efreet, trading his soul for eternal power. But the efreet betrayed him, trapping his spirit in the palace forever.
The palace fell into ruin after the vizier's death. The gardens withered, the towers crumbled, and the efreet remained, guarding the treasure that the vizier had hoarded.
The efreet that haunts Uzrah's Palace is not a ordinary fire spirit. It is ancient, powerful, and capricious — capable of granting wishes and destroying those who displease it.
Legend says that the efreet was once a djinni who fell in love with a mortal. When the mortal died, the djinni's grief turned to rage, and it became an efreet, burning everything it touched.
The efreet can be summoned with fire and gold, but it always demands a price. Those who try to trick it often find themselves burned.
The White Shark of Basra is not a typical pirate. He is old, cunning, and has spent decades searching for Uzrah's Palace.
His plan is to distribute his treasure on the island, using the palace as a base of operations. But he secretly seeks the vizier's artifact — an item of immense power hidden somewhere in the palace.
The White Shark knows about the efreet and has prepared offerings to appease it. Whether he can control it is another matter.
attributes.secrets: The White Shark's true goal is to bind the efreet to his will, using the vizier's artifact.

pages: An Arabian Nights-inspired dungeon adventure for 4-6 players, set on a remote island where a pirate lord plans to distribute his treasure among the ruins of a legendary palace.
The palace was once home to a vizier who made a bargain with an efreet. Now the ruins are haunted by the efreet, filled with traps and monsters, and guarded by the White Shark's crew.
The party must navigate the ruins, deal with the efreet, and either claim the treasure or stop the White Shark's plans. The adventure features exploration, combat, and roleplaying opportunities.

attributes.effect: The efreet radiates intense heat. Within 30 feet, the air shimmers and flames dance at the edges of vision.
attributes.mechanical_notes: Creatures within 30 feet of the efreet take 1d6 fire damage at the start of their turn. Fire-resistant creatures are immune.

attributes.effect: The palace is ancient and unstable. Dust falls from the ceiling, and stones shift underfoot.
attributes.mechanical_notes: Running or charging in the ruins requires a DC 10 Dexterity check or fall prone. Loud noises may trigger cave-ins (DM's discretion).

attributes.effect: The spirits of the palace's former inhabitants linger. Whispers echo, and shadows move on their own.
attributes.mechanical_notes: Creatures with the Haunted One background have advantage on saves against fear effects in the palace. Others must make a DC 12 Wisdom save when entering a new area or be frightened for 1 minute.

582c571c-1c57-582c-82c58-582c571c582c.name: Cobra
582c571c-1c57-582c-82c58-582c571c582c.description: A small venomous snake found in the palace ruins. Quick and aggressive when threatened.

37bd9633-3396-57bd-8bd37-37bd963337bd.name: Ghul-Bird
37bd9633-3396-57bd-8bd37-37bd963337bd.description: An undead bird with skeletal wings and glowing eyes. Hunts in packs and swarms its prey.

328c4c9a-9a4c-528c-88c32-328c4c9a328c.name: Dodecaphage
328c4c9a-9a4c-528c-88c32-328c4c9a328c.description: A massive aberration with twelve mouths arranged in a circle. Devours anything it encounters.

2adecc80-80cc-5ade-8de2a-2adecc802ade.name: Death Chanter
2adecc80-80cc-5ade-8de2a-2adecc802ade.description: A giant humanoid that chants death incantations. Its voice can weaken and frighten foes.

6e3b3732-3237-5e3b-83b6e-6e3b37326e3b.name: Filcher
6e3b3732-3237-5e3b-83b6e-6e3b37326e3b.description: A small, nimble creature that steals items and hides in shadows.

1ac03df0-f03d-5ac0-8c01a-1ac03df01ac0.name: Hyena of Shiraz
1ac03df0-f03d-5ac0-8c01a-1ac03df01ac0.description: A magical hyena with supernatural intelligence and cunning. Often serves as a familiar or mount.

7ba34c14-144c-5ba3-8a37b-7ba34c147ba3.name: Smothering Carpet
7ba34c14-144c-5ba3-8a37b-7ba34c147ba3.description: An animated carpet that wraps around and suffocates its victims.

5efc96c5-c596-5efc-8fc5e-5efc96c55efc.name: Twin-Maw Ghariq
5efc96c5-c596-5efc-8fc5e-5efc96c55efc.description: A bizarre creature with two mouths, one on each end of its body. Attacks from both directions.

6a511111-1111-5a51-8516a-6a5111116a51.name: Ufrayta
6a511111-1111-5a51-8516a-6a5111116a51.description: A shadowy, ethereal creature that can phase through walls and ceilings.

164c8f08-088f-564c-84c16-164c8f08164c.name: Zagrossian Lion
164c8f08-088f-564c-84c16-164c8f08164c.description: A massive lion with magical fur that shimmers like starlight. Fierce and territorial.

attributes.personality_traits: Always faces east when sharpening his sword. Attached to his prayer charms. Believes the sky keeps men sane.
attributes.ideals: Code of Honor. Hospitality is sacred. Never break your word.
attributes.bonds: Fascinated by history. Keeps tiny packets of desert salt to throw at evil spirits.
attributes.flaws: Honesty - must obey the law. Guilt Complex. Selfless.
attributes.backstory: Ghazi Holy Warrior of the Arabian lands. A man of deep faith and rigid honor, Jamal carries the weight of his vows like armor heavier than any steel.

attributes.personality_traits: Secretly fears deep water. Laughs quietly whenever danger becomes especially severe. Keeps meticulous records of debts, favors, and insults. Collects expensive perfumes from every city she visits.
attributes.ideals: Comfortable Wealth. Starting wealth is twice normal.
attributes.bonds: Deeply vain about her hair. Mistaken Identity - someone important thinks she is someone else.
attributes.backstory: A fire-touched sorceress of noble blood, Farah carries flames in her veins and ambition in her heart. Her past is wrapped in mistaken identity - someone powerful believes she is another.

attributes.personality_traits: Always looking for the angle. Quick with a knife and quicker with a lie.
attributes.ideals: Freedom. Everyone should be free to live as they choose.
attributes.bonds: Owes a debt to a powerful merchant prince.
attributes.flaws: Greed. Cannot resist a valuable target.
attributes.backstory: The Son of Darkness, Ibn al-Aswad is a thief of legendary skill who operates in the shadows of Basra's bazaars.

attributes.personality_traits: Compassionate and devout. Sees the divine in all things.
attributes.ideals: Faith. The gods work through us.
attributes.bonds: Devoted to healing the sick and protecting the innocent.
attributes.backstory: A priestess of the old faith, Naja carries the blessing of the moon goddess. Her mace is inscribed with prayers in a forgotten tongue.

attributes.personality_traits: Loud, boisterous, and loves a good fight. Never turns down a drink or a dare.
attributes.ideals: Loyalty. A pirate's word is their bond.
attributes.bonds: Sworn to find the legendary White Shark's treasure.
attributes.backstory: A weathered sea dog who has sailed every water from the Pearl Seas to the Burning Coast. Palmtree earned his name from the tattoo on his chest.

attributes.personality_traits: Obsessed with numerical patterns. Speaks in equations when excited.
attributes.ideals: Knowledge. The universe is a puzzle to be solved.
attributes.bonds: Searching for the lost mathematical proofs of the ancients.
attributes.flaws: Absent-minded. Forgets practical matters while lost in thought.
attributes.backstory: A scholar of the mystic arts, Qasim believes all magic can be reduced to numbers. His 'digitology' is considered eccentric by mainstream wizards.

attributes.personality_traits: Speaks little, observes everything. Moves like a shadow.
attributes.bonds: Tracks a rare creature that once saved her life.
attributes.flaws: Solitary. Struggles in crowds and cities.
attributes.backstory: Known only as The Owl, this silent ranger has watched over the borderlands for years. Few have seen her face; fewer have earned her trust.
